notes.title: A Guide to the Official Launch of the Game
notes.notes:
We are sorry to share important news with you who love games. I've been working hard to get the game released on schedule, but an unexpected serious error has occurred.

It wasn't easy to make a decision in this situation, but we put the quality and stability of the game first. As a result, the game release schedule has been postponed for a while.

We're working hard to resolve it quickly, and we're trying to fix the errors as quickly as possible to give you the best gaming experience. The exact release schedule will be announced later, and we ask for your continued support and understanding in this process.

We deeply apologize for the disappointment and inconvenience this has caused you. We are working hard for a better game, and we will do our best to repay your expectations and love.

Thank you.

Team YGAMES

notes.title: THE LAST BREATH is released.
notes.notes:
[b][Game Release Announcement][/b]

Dear players,

We are proud and excited to share our new game with you! We are grateful to be a part of this special moment, and would like to share with you some important information about the game launch.

[b]Update:[/b]
Our game is launching in Early Access, and will be available for general release after a month of updates.

[b]Support & Contact:[/b]
If you have any questions or problems during gameplay, please contact us via our official website or customer support email ([email protected]). Our team will do their best to help you.
[b]Community:[/b]
We'll be connecting with you and sharing news by providing links to our game community and social media, so you don't miss out on new updates, events, and more.

We appreciate your patience as we wait for the game to launch,
and we hope you enjoy your time in our new game world. We wish all our players the best of luck and fun together.

Thank you!

Y GAMES
